en: Lightning strikes the Earth about forty times every single second, mostly over tropical oceans.
Antarctica is technically the world's largest desert because it receives very little rain or snow each year.
It takes nature up to five hundred years to create just one single inch of fertile topsoil.
Pumice is a volcanic rock that is so full of air bubbles it can float on water.
The water you drink today is the exact same water that dinosaurs drank millions of years ago.
A single day on Venus lasts longer than its entire year because it rotates so slowly.
A single teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh about six billion tons on Earth.
Because the Moon has no wind or rain, astronaut footprints left there will stay there forever.
In the deep ocean, a tsunami wave can travel as fast as a commercial jet airplane.
The solid iron inner core of the Earth is as hot as the surface of the Sun.
An average fluffy cumulus cloud weighs about one million pounds, which equals one hundred elephants.
A comet's glowing tail always points directly away from the Sun because of the solar wind.
